ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the “Schematic Map of the Location of the Svalbard Archipelago” where China’s Arctic Yellow River Station (78°55′N, 11°56′E) is located. <image1> Approximately how many kilometers is the distance between Yellow River Station and the North Pole?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic map of the location of the Spitsbergen Archipelago; longitude lines labeled about 10°, 20°, and 30° can be seen, and a latitude line labeled about 80°; the red “Yellow River Station” point is located in the western part of the archipelago, consistent with the position given in the question stem that Yellow River Station is in the Spitsbergen Archipelago in the Arctic region. Then reason: the question stem gives the latitude of Yellow River Station as 78°55′N. The shortest spherical distance to the North Pole is calculated along the meridian direction; the latitude of the North Pole is 90°N, so the longitude 11°56′E does not affect the distance to the North Pole. The latitude difference is 90°00′−78°55′=11°05′, that is about 11.08°. Calculated according to about 111 kilometers for each 1° difference in latitude, 11.08×111≈1230 kilometers, taking an approximation, it is about 1200 kilometers.
